body_text:
Let $f$ have an isolated singularity at $z_0$ with Laurent expansion
$f(z) = \sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty a_n (z - z_0)^n$. The *residue* of $f$ at $z_0$, denoted
$\operatorname{Res}(f, z_0)$, is the coefficient of the power $(z - z_0)^{-1}$:
$$ \operatorname{Res}(f, z_0) = a_{-1} = \frac{1}{2\pi i} \oint_{C_\rho(z_0)} f(z)\,dz, $$
where $C_\rho(z_0)$ is any sufficiently small circle centered at $z_0$ oriented counterclockwise.
The residue is the unique coefficient in the Laurent series whose integral around $z_0$ does not vanish.
